candidate_decisions.reason: The trusted pericope nomination has exact focus carriers for steep passage and dangerous entry, with independent pericope carriers for inescapable trouble and an enclosing mountain form. Their contact changes the pass from bare terrain into a costly ordeal; all five supplied branch refs land in the dedicated finding.

The paired 90:18 and 90:19 outcome labels supply blessing, ill omen, and visible-sign carriers that independently qualify the focus pass as a route toward marked consequences. The focus outcome branch and all three nominated branches are retained.

The focus substitution-and-hold branch contacts the supplied release, surety, and undertaking carriers in 90:13 and 90:17. The independent mechanism is risk and liability remaining attached until release, so the candidate is materially distinct from a direct captive-release scene.

The focus retreat branch has an independent pericope contact in the supplied responsiveness, shortfall, and reciprocal-counsel carriers. Feeding, the orphan, and mutual exhortation form a concrete correction process whose success can reverse into relapse; all four branches land.

The focus hold/substitute branch meets the exact release and neck carriers in 90:13 and the surety carrier in 90:17. This supports a bounded captive or pledged-person release scene with a distinct embodied human locus, so none of the four branch refs is omitted.

The focus retreat branch meets supplied watchfulness, separation, coercion, and aversion carriers across 90:13, 90:19, and 90:20. The resulting withdrawal mechanism and its distance boundary are materially distinct and all five branch refs land.

The two focus succession branches meet the rear/successor carrier and the joining-continuity carrier in the same pericope. This creates a repeatable sequence and cycle mechanism rather than merely restating a single crossing; all four branches land.

The focus outcome and remaining-trace facets meet the supplied joining, testament, and executor image in 90:17. The resulting relation is an instruction or consequence surviving its source, distinct from generic succession; all four branches land.

The focus plant-withering and remainder facets have independent carriers in the acidic-fruit image at 90:17 and the fruit-covering image at 90:19. Their shared growth-to-dryness mechanism materially changes the threshold into a seasonal image; all four branches land.

The focus advanced-age facet meets exact pericope carriers for bereft parentage, the old man, and a woman without a spouse. These contacts produce a dependency-and-loss scene with a significant human payoff, and all four branch refs land.

The exact reconstructed HFT trace names the repeated focus noun, the 90:12 question, and a supplied knowledge carrier returning to the focus. The literal pass remains live while its operative identity is reopened; the unresolved branch is retained as attributed evidence.

The exact HFT trace coordinates the focus entry and pass with the 90:13 opening and neck carriers. Its binding-to-release mechanism changes the direction of crossing while remaining attributed to a legacy-unbound source; all five branch refs land.

The exact HFT trace coordinates the focus with feeding during a famine-day and hunger, and supplies focus drought and plant facets. That is a specific solidarity mechanism with a changed direction of movement; unresolved context branches remain attributed and all five refs land.

The exact HFT trace coordinates the focus with nearness, orphaned support, immobility, and dust-poverty in 90:15-16. These carriers produce a concrete inversion of social distance, with unresolved branches kept attributed; all seven refs land.

The exact HFT trace links focus entry and succession with reciprocal counsel, endurance, mercy, and companionship in 90:17-18. This is a social relay mechanism rather than a duplicate of temporal succession; unresolved branches remain attributed and all eight refs land.

The exact HFT trace links avoided entry with release, covering, fire, and enclosure across the pericope. The open-to-sealed directional mechanism is specific and contained; unresolved branches remain attributed and all six refs land.

The supplied outlier trace exactly coordinates the focus hold/consequence branch with release of a pledge or captive neck in 90:13. Its commercial-legal relation is bounded and explicitly exploratory, so it remains visible as an attributed finding rather than being collapsed into the other release readings.

findings.title: Steep pass as inescapable ordeal
findings.claim: The focus clause becomes a scene of costly entry into a steep pass that has the character of an inescapable ordeal.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for steep passage and dangerous entry meet the pericope carriers for severe trouble and an enclosing mountain form, changing the pass from bare terrain into a threshold that demands exposure.
findings.reader_payoff: The pass is felt as a difficult threshold requiring costly entry rather than smooth upward movement.
findings.containment: The ordinary steep-pass reading remains intact; the pericope does not establish one exclusive physical shape or a whole-surah thesis.

epistemic.reason: Every supplied branch has a packet carrier and an independent pericope trigger, while the synthesis remains a bounded contextual inference from a reviewed nomination.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sarp dağ geçidi ve kayalık çıkıntı
branch_activations.facet_statement: Dağdaki yol yukarı yönelir, sarptır ve geçilmesi belirgin güçlük taşır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries a steep upward mountain passage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The repeated question in 90:12 and the severe-trouble image attached to the later endurance context make the passage an ordeal rather than an easy route.
branch_activations.activation: The focus pass is the concrete carrier, while the question and severe-trouble context supply the independent pressure that makes its difficulty operative.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failed crossing is a costly encounter with a steep, hard-to-bypass threshold.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the mountain-pass substrate and does not define a single literal geography.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi, sonucunu ölçmeden veya yolu bilmeden güç ya da korkutucu bir şeyin içine atılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries forceful entry into danger.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The explicit pass object and the following question identify the dangerous object into which entry occurs.
branch_activations.activation: The verb's self-involving entry meets the steep-pass object and makes the difficulty a bodily exposure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing is an exposed plunge into a difficult threshold.
branch_activations.boundary: The reading preserves forceful entry and does not turn every ascent into reckless action.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: tehlikeli engel, büyük güçlük veya kötü sonuç
branch_activations.facet_statement: Adlandırılan şey, insanı yıkıma götürebilen veya herkesin göze alamayacağı kadar büyük olan tehlikeli güçlüktür.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus verb carries the dangerous difficulty encountered in the entry.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The named pass supplies the separate obstacle against which the entry is measured.
branch_activations.activation: The verb and object meet as an act confronting a large, dangerous difficulty rather than a routine climb.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pass is an obstacle whose difficulty explains why entry is a meaningful act.
branch_activations.boundary: This is the danger facet of the focus verb and does not replace the noun's steep-pass sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: severe inescapable trouble
branch_activations.carrier: The later endurance word carries the supplied image of severe trouble without an easy outlet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus pass and its question provide the obstacle that the later severe-trouble image qualifies.
branch_activations.activation: The hard situation in the pericope supplies the pass with an inescapable ordeal pressure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pass remains a route, and it is also the kind of severe situation that must be entered and endured.
branch_activations.boundary: The image qualifies the route's difficulty; it does not equate every later hardship with the pass.

branch_activations.facet_statement: hidden pass or enclosing height
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:19 covering form carries the supplied image of a hidden pass or enclosing height.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus names a pass and the later outcome connection returns that image to the same route.
branch_activations.activation: The enclosing-height carrier gives the focus pass concealment and constriction in addition to steepness.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold is a projecting or hidden height whose difficulty is partly its enclosure.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual mountain image and does not assert that the later verb has the same ordinary meaning as the focus noun.

findings.title: A route marked by its consequence
findings.claim: The pass is framed as a route whose consequences become visible as a blessed or ill-omened side.
findings.mechanism: The focus outcome facet meets the paired 90:18 and 90:19 labels, while visible-sign and blessing/ill-omen carriers turn the route's results into directional indications.
findings.reader_payoff: The two later companies become marked destinations of the route rather than a detached classification after the pass.
findings.containment: The packet supports a local outcome and portent relation; it does not assert that every direction word everywhere carries an omen.

epistemic.reason: The focus outcome and all paired context carriers are exact and independently connected, while the sign-making synthesis remains contextual inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir süreç veya işin vardığı son durum ve nihai sonuç temel anlamı oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries an outcome facet alongside the concrete pass.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 90:18 and 90:19 provide paired consequence labels connected back to the focus route.
branch_activations.activation: The route's outcome facet meets the two named sides and makes consequence part of how the pass is recognized.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pass leads toward consequences that are visibly marked as favorable or adverse.
branch_activations.boundary: The outcome facet does not cancel the physical threshold or determine a single final interpretation.

branch_activations.facet_statement: a visible sign
branch_activations.carrier: The signs named in 90:19 carry a visible-mark image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus outcome branch and the paired side labels supply the route whose consequence is being marked.
branch_activations.activation: A visible sign makes the later consequence legible as an indication attached to the route.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What happens after the pass functions as a sign by which the route's direction can be read.
branch_activations.boundary: The sign image is local to the supplied consequence and does not make every sign an omen.

branch_activations.facet_statement: ill omen and misfortune
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:19 side carries an ill-omen and misfortune image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus pass is connected to the negative side as a consequence of the route.
branch_activations.activation: The ill-omen carrier supplies the adverse pole of the focus outcome relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route can terminate in a visibly adverse direction whose misfortune is part of its meaning.
branch_activations.boundary: This records the supplied ill-omen image without making it a universal causal rule.

branch_activations.facet_statement: blessing and good fortune
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:18 side carries a blessing and good-fortune image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The paired outcome structure and the focus pass supply the route to which this favorable side belongs.
branch_activations.activation: The blessing carrier supplies the favorable pole of the consequence relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route can terminate in a visibly favorable direction whose blessing is part of how the outcome is read.
branch_activations.boundary: The favorable image remains a contextual pole and does not erase the route's difficulty.

findings.title: Crossing as carried liability
findings.claim: Entering the pass can also be read as taking on a held obligation whose release requires substitution, surety, and discharge.
findings.mechanism: The focus substitution-and-hold facet contacts the release phrase and the later surety and undertaking carriers, changing the obstacle from terrain alone into an obligation still attached to a person or asset.
findings.reader_payoff: The act of crossing acquires an economic shape: someone carries the claim until release is possible.
findings.containment: This is a legal-economic overlay on the steep pass; it does not turn the whole ayah into a contract or erase the terrain.

epistemic.reason: The supplied focus and context branches have distinct carriers in 90:13 and 90:17, and the liability mechanism is bounded to their contact.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bedel, satış başvurusu ve elde tutma güvencesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin yerine başka bir bedel alınır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries a substitution and held-value facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The release act in 90:13 and the later surety context supply a separate obligation structure.
branch_activations.activation: The pass's focus branch meets release and guarantee carriers, making crossing resemble discharge of a held claim.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold is an obligation that must be carried or substituted before it can be released.
branch_activations.boundary: The retained-value facet is a local overlay and does not define the ordinary noun everywhere.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: freeing a pledge or neck from closure and bondage
branch_activations.facet_statement: freeing a pledge or neck from closure and bondage
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:13 release phrase carries freeing a pledge or neck from bondage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus substitution branch identifies the held thing whose release gives the pass a legal shape.
branch_activations.activation: Release is the operation that resolves the held obligation carried by the focus branch.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing includes making release possible for what is held under a claim.
branch_activations.boundary: The release carrier does not make every crossing a pledge transaction.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bearing surety or standing with someone
branch_activations.facet_statement: bearing surety or standing with someone
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:17 endurance word carries standing with someone and bearing liability.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The release and substitution carriers establish the claim that must be borne until discharge.
branch_activations.activation: Surety gives the economic overlay a person who carries the held obligation for another.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing can mean standing under another's claim until the held matter is released.
branch_activations.boundary: The surety image does not reduce the later counsel and endurance language to finance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: suretyship or undertaking responsibility
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:17 undertaking carrier supplies suretyship and responsibility for another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus hold branch and 90:13 release phrase identify the responsibility's object and endpoint.
branch_activations.activation: The undertaking carrier gives the held obligation a responsible bearer.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route through the pass includes accepting responsibility until another can be freed.
branch_activations.boundary: This is not a claim that the surface verb itself means guarantee.

findings.title: A contested movement toward reform
findings.claim: The failed entry can be seen as a contested attempt at reform: correction is offered, response may fall short, and the movement can turn back.
findings.mechanism: The focus retreat facet meets the supplied responsiveness, heedlessness, and reciprocal-exhortation carriers in 90:14-17, making the pass a process whose direction depends on how correction is received.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees an attempted change of direction that can become either response or relapse, not merely a static failure.
findings.containment: The correction scene is a local contextual overlay; it does not replace the physical pass or claim that every act of feeding is instruction.

epistemic.reason: All four nominated branches have exact pericope carriers and the source supplies a distinct correction-and-relapse mechanism, though the synthesis remains contextual.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Discernment, worth, or responsiveness
branch_activations.carrier: The feeding form in 90:14 carries the supplied discernment and responsiveness image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The reciprocal-counsel and orphan contexts provide the correction situation in which responsiveness matters.
branch_activations.activation: The carrier changes feeding from an isolated act into a test of response to repair and care.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route includes a recipient's capacity to receive correction and become responsive.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the ordinary feeding sense of the context word.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İleri gidişten sonra yön değiştirip geri çekilme hareketi anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the supplied retreat-after-forward-motion facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The correction, orphan, and reciprocal-counsel context supplies a process that can reverse after beginning.
branch_activations.activation: Retreat gives the focus failure a direction: an attempted movement can turn back when reform is neglected.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The unentered pass is also the point at which a corrective movement can reverse.
branch_activations.boundary: The retreat facet remains a contextual resonance and does not define the ordinary pass noun.

branch_activations.facet_statement: mutual exhortation among people
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated counsel forms in 90:17 carry mutual exhortation among people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The feeding and orphan contexts specify the difficult correction toward which counsel is directed.
branch_activations.activation: Mutual exhortation makes reform a shared process rather than a private impulse.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing the threshold includes people helping one another sustain a changed direction.
branch_activations.boundary: The mutual-counsel image does not claim that the focus clause itself contains the later verb.

branch_activations.facet_statement: heedlessness and falling short
branch_activations.carrier: The orphan carrier also supplies an image of heedlessness and falling short.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The counsel and correction context gives the shortfall a direction and a possible return.
branch_activations.activation: Shortfall supplies the failure mode that turns an attempted crossing into relapse.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route is difficult partly because neglect can undo the movement already begun.
branch_activations.boundary: The falling-short image is retained as a local contextual facet and does not define the recipient.

findings.title: The pass as captive release
findings.claim: The threshold also gathers the scene of a captive or pledged person whose release is the costly form of crossing.
findings.mechanism: The focus hold-and-substitute facet contacts the release and neck carriers in 90:13 and the surety carrier in 90:17, giving the threshold an embodied person whose bondage is changed by release.
findings.reader_payoff: Crossing becomes an act that frees a person held under another's claim, so the cost is carried toward another's freedom.
findings.containment: This is the captive-release scene within the local pass image; it shares release language with the separate liability reading without absorbing that risk-redistribution mechanism.

epistemic.reason: The four supplied branches have distinct exact carriers and a release-to-person mechanism in the pericope.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bedel, satış başvurusu ve elde tutma güvencesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir kişi veya şeyin yerine başka bir bedel alınır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries a substitution and hold facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The release phrase and neck carrier specify the person or pledge whose status changes.
branch_activations.activation: The focus hold facet makes the release act a costly form of crossing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pass is crossed by taking up the burden of a held person's release.
branch_activations.boundary: The legal facet remains an overlay and does not replace the steep-pass scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: freeing a pledge or neck from closure and bondage
branch_activations.facet_statement: freeing a pledge or neck from closure and bondage
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:13 phrase carries freeing a pledge or neck from closure and bondage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus pass's hold facet supplies the threshold that the release operation crosses.
branch_activations.activation: Release of what is held gives the pass a direction toward another's freedom.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The difficult route is an opening made in another person's bondage.
branch_activations.boundary: The release phrase remains one concrete specification and does not define every aspect of the focus.

branch_activations.facet_statement: neck, then person in bondage
branch_activations.carrier: The neck in 90:13 carries the embodied person-in-bondage image.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The release carrier supplies the operation that changes the neck's condition.
branch_activations.activation: The bodily locus turns an abstract obligation into a person whose bondage can be opened.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing is directed toward loosening a human constriction.
branch_activations.boundary: The metonymic person image remains tied to the supplied release scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: bearing surety or standing with someone
branch_activations.facet_statement: bearing surety or standing with someone
branch_activations.carrier: The endurance carrier supplies standing with another and bearing liability.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The captive or pledged person and the release phrase establish whose burden is being borne.
branch_activations.activation: Surety provides the human commitment that carries the release through the difficult threshold.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The person who crosses stands with the bound person until freedom is achieved.
branch_activations.boundary: The surety image supports the release scene without reducing the focus to a formal contract.

findings.title: Withdrawal at the threshold
findings.claim: The route can also be colored by recoil: a subject watches, breaks attachment, and turns back when pressure or coercion makes obedience unstable.
findings.mechanism: The focus retreat facet meets watchfulness, separation, coercion, and aversion carriers across 90:13, 90:19, and 90:20, giving the failed crossing a boundary-making movement away from contact.
findings.reader_payoff: The threshold becomes a place where distance is actively preserved, so refusal has a bodily and relational shape.
findings.containment: This withdrawal image remains one contextual overlay on the failed entry; it does not erase the possibility of costly approach or make refusal the sole reading.

epistemic.reason: Each supplied branch has an exact pericope carrier and the nomination states a coherent withdrawal mechanism with a clear boundary.

branch_activations.facet_statement: watching and expectant waiting
branch_activations.carrier: The neck carrier also supplies watching and expectant waiting.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus threshold and later refusal/enclosure contexts provide the danger being watched.
branch_activations.activation: Watchfulness gives the failed entry a subject who holds at a boundary and waits rather than crossing.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route is approached under guarded expectation, with distance itself becoming an action.
branch_activations.boundary: The waiting image does not assert a hidden actor or cancel the focus verb's entry pressure.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İleri gidişten sonra yön değiştirip geri çekilme hareketi anlatılır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the supplied retreat-after-forward-motion facet.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Release, covering, and final enclosure supply the surrounding acts against which retreat is read.
branch_activations.activation: The failed entry can be pictured as a turn back at the point of contact with the threshold.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route includes an active withdrawal from the approach.
branch_activations.boundary: The retreat facet is contextual and does not make the ordinary steep pass itself a retreat.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: separating from something or negating cessation
branch_activations.facet_statement: separating from something or negating cessation
branch_activations.carrier: The release phrase carries separation from an attached state.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus retreat facet supplies the direction from which separation is understood.
branch_activations.activation: Separation makes withdrawal a breaking of contact rather than simple absence of movement.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold is encountered through a choice or pressure to break attachment.
branch_activations.boundary: The separation image remains tied to the supplied release and refusal contacts.

branch_activations.facet_statement: making someone disobey
branch_activations.carrier: The 90:19 covering form carries the image of driving an obedient person into disobedience.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus retreat and later sealed outcome supply the pressure and boundary around obedience.
branch_activations.activation: Coercion explains withdrawal as a response to pressure that changes the subject's relation to obedience.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The failed crossing can include a pressured break from a prior line of obedience.
branch_activations.boundary: This is a contextual coercion image, not a claim that the 90:19 verb has only this sense.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: aversion, flight, and lack of steadiness
branch_activations.facet_statement: aversion, flight, and lack of steadiness
branch_activations.carrier: The fire carrier carries aversion, flight, and lack of steadiness.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus route and terminal enclosure provide the boundary from which recoil is understood.
branch_activations.activation: Aversion gives the route a subject that recoils from the approach and cannot hold a steady line.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold exposes a flight response that preserves distance from the danger.
branch_activations.boundary: The aversion image does not describe the final enclosure as a literal fleeing animal.

findings.title: A crossing that continues by return
findings.claim: The one-time plunge can be read as a sequence that continues by succession, return, and replacement.
findings.mechanism: The focus succession and repeated-action facets meet a rear/successor carrier and a joining-continuity carrier, changing the crossing from a single instant into a sequence that can recur.
findings.reader_payoff: The threshold becomes part of an order that continues after one person's movement, with each stage taking up what the previous stage leaves.
findings.containment: The cycle image deepens the focus event without making repetition a condition of the ordinary verb or claiming a complete temporal system.

epistemic.reason: Both focus facets and both context carriers have exact pericope contact and a distinct succession mechanism.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: birbirinin ardından gelme ve yerini alma
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sonraki öğe öncekinin ardından gelir ve onun bıraktığı yeri alır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries succession and replacement after one stage.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later joining and rear/successor carriers supply an order in which stages follow one another.
branch_activations.activation: The focus threshold becomes a place in a sequence where a later stage takes up a prior position.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing is connected to a continuing relay rather than ending at the first attempt.
branch_activations.boundary: The succession facet does not turn the focus noun into a general time marker.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Daha önce yapılmış bir işin ardından aynı tür iş yeniden gerçekleştirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries repetition of the same kind of work.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The later repeated-counsel context supplies a concrete return beyond one crossing.
branch_activations.activation: Repeated action makes the pass an activity that can be taken up again after an earlier stage.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The route remains open as a recurring practice rather than a one-time feat.
branch_activations.boundary: The repeated-action facet is contextual and does not claim that the focus verb is iterative in grammar.

branch_activations.facet_statement: rear, successor, or trailing end
branch_activations.carrier: The neck occurrence carries a rear or successor image in the supplied branch.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus succession facets provide the sequence in which a rear or successor has a role.
branch_activations.activation: A successor at the rear gives the crossing a position within an ordered relay.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What follows the first entrant can occupy the place left behind and continue the movement.
branch_activations.boundary: The successor image is not a claim about the ordinary anatomy of the neck.

branch_activations.facet_statement: joining one thing to another
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated counsel forms carry joining one thing to another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus succession and rear/successor images provide the stages that are joined.
branch_activations.activation: Joining supplies continuity between one crossing stage and the next.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The threshold becomes part of a connected sequence in which movement is handed forward.
branch_activations.boundary: The joining image remains tied to the supplied sequence and does not assert an unlimited chain.

findings.title: What remains after the instruction
findings.claim: The pass's consequence can be read as what remains after an instruction passes to another person.
findings.mechanism: The focus outcome and remaining-trace facets meet the joining and testament carriers in 90:17, changing consequence into an aftermath that continues through another person's responsibility.
findings.reader_payoff: The route gains a durable after-effect: what is done here can remain active after its source has passed from the scene.
findings.containment: This is a bounded continuity-and-aftermath overlay; it does not turn the focus into a testament or state that every consequence survives indefinitely.

epistemic.reason: The supplied focus facets and both 90:17 continuity/testament branches have exact carriers and a specific survival mechanism.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir süreç veya işin vardığı son durum ve nihai sonuç temel anlamı oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries the result reached by a process.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 90:17 instruction and continuity carriers supply a process whose result can be carried forward.
branch_activations.activation: The result facet meets the survival of an instruction and becomes an aftermath rather than a terminal instant.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The pass has a consequence that remains active through what follows.
branch_activations.boundary: The result remains tied to the supplied continuity image and does not imply permanence in every case.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: geride kalan son parça ya da iz
branch_activations.facet_statement: Önceki şey tükendikten veya değiştikten sonra ondan bir bölüm ya da iz kalır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus noun carries a remaining piece or trace after change.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The testament and executor carriers supply the later state in which something from the earlier act remains.
branch_activations.activation: The remaining-trace facet gives the focus consequence a residue that can be inherited.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: What follows the crossing includes a trace that continues to operate after the first act.
branch_activations.boundary: The trace image does not claim that the focus noun ordinarily means residue.

branch_activations.facet_statement: joining one thing to another
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated counsel forms carry joining one thing to another.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus's result and trace facets supply the earlier thing that must be joined to what follows.
branch_activations.activation: Joining lets the later person or action take up the trace of the earlier one.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The consequence crosses the boundary between one agent and the next through continuity.
branch_activations.boundary: The joining image is limited to the supplied continuity relation.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: a charge joined to another person
branch_activations.facet_statement: a charge joined to another person
branch_activations.carrier: The counsel forms carry a charge joined to another person.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus result and remaining trace supply a prior act whose responsibility can be passed on.
branch_activations.activation: The charge carrier makes aftermath personal: another person is appointed to carry what remains.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Crossing can leave a task or consequence entrusted to the next bearer.

findings.title: An exploratory retained claim
findings.claim: Exploratorily, the pass resembles a retained claim that is cleared by assuming and discharging liability attached to a neck.
findings.mechanism: The exact outlier trace joins the focus substitution-and-consequence facets to release of a pledge or captive neck in 90:13, changing the obstacle into a claim held against a person and cleared through discharge.
findings.reader_payoff: A steep obstacle can also be pictured as a claim held against a person, making crossing an act of discharge.
findings.containment: This is a commercial-legal overlay on the ordinary steep-pass sense. The packet leaves live the alternative that release is one example on the far side of a primarily topographic metaphor.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT outlier trace supplies matching coordinates and a contained changed reading, but its source is legacy-unbound and its own record marks the inference exploratory.
